notes.title: Demo Update: Public Lobbies
notes.content:
Hello everyone, We have released a major update to the demo, including public lobbies and important improvements.



Changelog:

Public lobbies enabled

You can now set your lobby name and choose public or invite only options when creating lobbies

Send Steam friend requests directly to other players in-game

Hosts can now kick players before the match starts

In-game critical notifications for when players leave, get kicked or disconnect due to internet issues

Spectator mode for downed players, also indicators showing who is spectating you

Network optimization and increased bandwidth

Fixed an issue where background friend info requests caused network hitches

Improved UI



What’s Next:

We are also working on a significant gameplay and visual overhaul that will be released in one to two months. This update will bring the demo closer to the full game experience.



Planned features include:

A brand-new custom player character model and gameplay (a big surprise we cannot wait to share)

The demo puzzle section is getting a rework that keeps things simple but makes the experience more fun

Monsters will be able to break doors and obstacles

Players will gain the ability to build and repair broken doors and obstacles, as well as set traps to survive

Additional unique player abilities (to be revealed later)

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just uploaded a minor update to the demo that fixes a few small issues. Here is the Changelog:


Improved text chat: Improved text chat. Notifications now indicate when new messages arrive while viewing previous messages. Clicking a notification will scroll the chat to the latest message. Previously, new messages sometimes did not scroll correctly. This is now fixed.

Friend invitations: Non-host players can now invite friends to the game.

Graphics fixes: FXAA has been temporarily disabled due to an engine bug that caused crashes on low-end GPUs. DLSS has also been disabled on AMD GPUs to prevent crashes.

Audio fixes: The mute function sometimes did not work after multiple session restarts. This is now fixed.

Other fixes and adjustments: Several minor bugs have been fixed and quality-of-life improvements have been made.

notes.title: Demo Patch: Networking Fixes & Smoother Gameplay
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

We’ve just released a patch addressing several critical bugs and crashes in the demo, along with other improvements. Here’s the full list of changes:


Improved Networking: We’ve implemented a new networking technique that should help players with strict network rules connect to each other via NAT punch-through. Please let us know if you’re still experiencing connectivity issues, as your feedback will help us pinpoint the problem more precisely.

Crash Fix on Host Exit: Fixed an issue where the game would crash if the host left or restarted while players were using voice chat.

Smoother Interaction: Hold interactions (e.g., holding a button to perform an action) are now handled locally. This significantly reduces input delay and improves responsiveness, especially for players with higher ping.

Animation Bug Fix: Resolved a bug where animations would break when all players died.

Settings Bug Fix for New Players: Fixed an issue where newly joined players without a save file would experience broken or missing settings—particularly audio and voice settings.

Audio Adjustments: Rebalanced overall audio volumes and made several minor adjustments to improve sound quality and consistency.



Thanks for all your feedback and support!

notes.title: Voice/Text Chat and Optimization Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,



We’ve just released a major update to the demo! Here's the full list of improvements and changes:

Voice Chat: Both proximity-based and 2D voice chat are now available. Voice effects that match the environment (such as echo) are included. You can disable these effects if you prefer. Additional features include player muting, push to talk, noise suppression and voice detection sensitivity settings.

Text Chat: Text chat is now available both in the lobby and in-game for players without a microphone.

Performance Optimizations: We've made broader optimizations and improved the quality settings. Presets now have a more noticeable and tailored impact on performance.

FSR Support: AMD’s FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) has been added to the upscaler options.

Upscaler Fixes: Previously, only DLSS was functioning correctly. This has been resolved and all upscalers, including FSR, now work as intended.

If you're using an AMD GPU, please let us know if enabling FSR improves your performance.

Item Use Bug Fixed: Players could scroll through active items, but the wrong item would sometimes be used. This is now fixed.

Interaction While Dead Fixed: Dead players were previously able to interact with objects. This is no longer possible.

FPS and Ping Counter: You can now enable FPS and ping counters via the settings menu.

Build Versioning: Build versions are now shown in-game to help with debugging and synchronization.

Miscellaneous: Numerous minor improvements and bug fixes have been implemented.

Important Notes:

To use voice chat, make sure your microphone is properly selected in your Windows sound settings. The game uses the default system input device.

If voice proximity is not working and all voice sounds are 2D, try deleting your save files located at:

C:\\Users\\\\AppData\\Local\\\\Saved\\SaveGames\\



Thanks for your continued support, keep the feedback coming guys!

notes.title: SteamNext Fest Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone

A new update is now live just in time for Steam Next Fest. This patch focuses on improving control customization, accessibility, and overall player experience. Here is what has changed:



Key Rebinding Override

Players can now fully rebind inputs across keyboard, mouse, and controller. Used keys can be overridden freely to fit any playstyle



Controller Support Improvements

Players can now sprint by pressing the joystick button such as L3

A new left-handed mode has been added allowing players to swap the functions of movement and camera joysticks



Crash Fix

Resolved an issue where certain party members could experience a crash when returning to the main menu



Lighting and Visual Update

Improved map visuals with updated moody lighting for a more atmospheric experience



Translation Corrections

Adjusted and corrected translation errors in several supported languages



Performance Optimization

Made general improvements to performance and stability



Bug Fixes

Addressed various minor bugs reported by players

Fixed issues related to AI pathfinding behavior, improving movement reliability and navigation consistency

notes.title: Demo Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just released an update to the demo with several improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

Update Highlights:

The Field of View slider now offers a wider range to better suit different player preferences.
Some players had difficulty locating small key objects due to the medium-to-large map size. If you take too long to find an important object, a ping marker will now appear to help guide you.
Stalkers now have an additional new behavior that gives players brief moments to breathe while enhancing the overall tension and creepiness.
The diner area has been reworked to be more lore-accurate and atmospheric. It plays a key role in puzzle progression for the full game, so this gives you a preview of what’s to come.
Various small adjustments have been made to enhance the overall experience.


Coming in the Next Update:

We’re adding support for multiple languages to make the game more accessible.
Rebinding controls will override previously used keys instead of locking them out, making customization more intuitive.
Additional changes and fixes are on the way based on your continued feedback.


Thanks for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts. We’re listening closely and continuing to improve the experience as we build toward the full release.

Let us know what you think on the Steam forums or Discord.
